name: an_offer_you_cant_refuse_cannot_target_a_creature_spell
notes: Printed: 'Counter target noncreature spell.' Seat 0 casts Savannah Lions (a creature spell) and holds priority; it may not target the Lions with its own An Offer You Can't Refuse (illegal target: nothing is paid, nothing is countered). The Lions stay on the stack and the Offer stays in hand with its mana in the pool.
